# Predict-A-Trade

> Predict-A-Trade is an explainable XAUUSD market-intelligence platform operated by Simha Fintech LLC in Dubai, UAE. It covers technical indicators, market structure, liquidity, trading sessions, and multi-timeframe context. Developed by Mehulkumar Bhatt.

## About
- Official website: https://predictatrade.com/
- Canonical URL: https://predictatrade.com/
- Primary asset: XAUUSD / Gold
- Analysis type: Technical, educational, explainable
- Publisher: Simha Fintech LLC, Dubai, UAE
- Developer: Mehulkumar Bhatt
- Public email: predictatrade@gmail.com
- Contact: https://predictatrade.com/#contact
- Language: English

## Core Topics
- [Market Structure](https://predictatrade.com/#approach) – Trend direction, break of structure, highs and lows, range vs trend.
- [Liquidity](https://predictatrade.com/#methodology) – Liquidity pools, stop hunts, session liquidity, inducement.
- [Indicators](https://predictatrade.com/#methodology) – Technical indicators used for XAUUSD analysis.
- [Trading Sessions](https://predictatrade.com/#methodology) – Asian, London, and New York sessions and volatility patterns.
- [Multi-Timeframe Analysis](https://predictatrade.com/#methodology) – Combining higher-timeframe context with lower-timeframe execution.

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://predictatrade.com/) – Main entry point and latest analysis.
- [Contact](https://predictatrade.com/#contact) – Questions, feedback, and contact details.
